verdict.rationale: Community commenters point to an official Postmark MCP server at postmarkapp.com/lp/mcp and to the official ActiveCampaign/postmark-mcp GitHub repo. That repo reportedly has very little adoption, and the malicious 'postmark-mcp' npm package discussed in the thread was a third-party impersonator, so it does not contradict the official server's existence. However, nothing in the first-party docs pack describes the server, its tools, or how to set it up, so support rests on second-hand mentions. Missing for 10: first-party MCP documentation (setup, auth, exposed tools), evidence of which API capabilities the server covers, and hands-on corroboration that agents can connect and work through it.
